# Icecube Events

> Icecube Event Management Pvt. Ltd. is an event management company headquartered in Kochi, Kerala, India, operating since 2009. It plans and produces corporate conferences, government and defence events, international conferences, product launches, inaugurations, exhibition stalls, mall activations, team-building programmes, fashion shows and roadshows across India.
